method: Four built-in imagegen calls; no CLI or separate API key. Prompt specs below summarize the generation requirements. Original generated alpha preserved during proportional downscaling and PNG/WebP encoding; backgrounds compressed as JPEG.
reference: User-provided watermarked flowerhorn image inspected for species anatomy only; stock image itself was not cleaned, distributed or placed in the site.

Original realistic flowerhorn fish with rounded forehead, pearlescent rainbow scales and a small natural-looking dark plum felt witch-like hat, right-facing side profile, entire fish visible, opaque body on true transparent background, no text, watermark or copied stock-photo composition.

Spacious photorealistic underwater aquarium, Turkish red flag with accurate white crescent and five-pointed star far in the back, balanced red and white corals near the sides, open water and pale sandy floor for swimmers, natural underwater sunlight, no fish, UI or text.

Spacious photorealistic underwater New Year aquarium, tasteful sparse natural edge decorations, small warm garland far behind, balanced ornaments among corals and pale snow-like sand, clear central swimming space and clear lower-right space for a separate 3D snowman, no fish, UI or text; no baked-in snowman.
